prompt: The wrestler walks FORWARD down the entrance ramp TOWARD the camera and foreground for the entire shot. His feet take natural forward heel-to-toe steps toward the viewer; his hips, torso, and shoulders advance in the same direction. He never retreats. Start with him slightly farther away, then he becomes subtly larger as he approaches. The camera slowly dollies backward to maintain framing while he continues advancing forward. Add realistic arm swing, body weight transfer, active crowd movement, drifting smoke, arena light flicker, and brief pyrotechnic bursts. Premium cinematic wrestling broadcast look, low-angle hero framing, realistic anatomy, preserve face and body proportions. No text changes, no captions, no generated audio.
